body:
I'd be in favor of having `clear_before_printing` be the default behavior without configuration, at least until we find out it is needed. I have done some local testing in each of the supported shells and haven't run into any issues.

I think it will be otherwise difficult to explain the value of this configuration option to users, and it will just end up being a suggested fix to the rare user that reports a bug on GitHub.

Do you think that makes sense?
